mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz ( course_id, title, description, time_limit, total_marks, start_time, end_time, status, created_by ) VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{timeLimit}, #{totalMarks}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE quiz SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, time_limit = #{timeLimit}, total_marks = #{totalMarks}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId}
UPDATE quiz SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId}
mapper.select: SELECT quiz_id, course_id, title, description, time_limit, total_marks, start_time, end_time, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM quiz WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} LIMIT 1

SELECT q.quiz_id, q.course_id, c.title AS course_title, q.title, q.description, q.time_limit, q.total_marks, q.start_time, q.end_time, q.status, q.created_by, a.full_name AS creator_name, q.created_at, q.updated_at FROM quiz q LEFT JOIN course c ON q.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN account a ON q.created_by = a.account_id WHERE q.quiz_id = #{quizId} LIMIT 1
